lines.t: Rain falls on the ruins I made,
Whispers echo what I can’t escape.
I built my pride from rust and smoke,
Now I’m breathing truth I almost broke.
Shadows tried to pull me under,
But I heard Your voice like thunder.
Light through the black sky,
Burn through the fear I hide.
When the world caves in,
You pull me back again.
Oh, light through the black sky —
Shine through the pain I denied.
You find me where I can’t see,
Your mercy still believes in me.
Mirrors show the ghost of my past,
Promises fade but Your grace lasts.
I’ve walked alone through my own fire,
But You turned my ashes into choir.
Every wound becomes a story,
When I’m standing in Your glory.
Light through the black sky,
Burn through the fear I hide.
When the world caves in,
You pull me back again.
Oh, light through the black sky —
Shine through the pain I denied.
You find me where I can’t see,
Your mercy still believes in me.
If I fall into the dark again,
Will You call my name like You did back then?
Every star reminds my soul —
Even night can’t take control.
Light through the black sky,
Tear through my guarded mind.
All my doubts fade in Your flame,
I’m reborn in Your name.
Oh, light through the black sky —
You’re the reason I survive.
When my faith begins to bleed,
Your love still carries me.
Through the black sky…
You carry me home.
You carry me home.
